claims.text: Flat warts: daily tretinoin 0.05% cream; if peeling isn't enough, apply 5% benzoyl peroxide or 5% salicylic acid cream sequentially with it
claims.quote: Usual first-line treatment is daily tretinoin (retinoic acid 0.05% cream). If peeling is not sufficient for wart removal, another irritant (eg, 5% benzoyl peroxide) or 5% SCA cream can be applied sequentially with tretinoin.
